data.one_liner: iOS and macOS implementation of the video_player plugin
data.what_it_does: Provides native video playback on iOS and macOS, including AirPlay routing, track selection, and display sleep prevention.
use_when: You need video playback on iOS or macOS
You want native performance and AirPlay support
You are already using the video_player plugin
avoid_when: You target Android, web, or other platforms
You need a cross‑platform video solution
strengths: AirPlay routing and external screen support
Video and audio track selection APIs
weaknesses: Requires the video_player plugin to be used

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: Cross‑platform implementation that automatically includes this package when used

alternatives.name: video_player_android
alternatives.why_pick_it: Android specific implementation if you need platform‑specific features
